meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会接手 Git 操作:原子提交、rebase/squash 历史改写、blame/bisect/reflog 历史查证。它先读仓库状态再下判断,只执行你明确要求的写操作,并报告提交哈希与命令证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 git 历史时触发;普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把当前改动按原子提交分成几个 commit
say.note: 先看 diff 再按行为分组暂存并逐个提交

say.text: 查一下这行代码最后是谁改的
say.note: 用 git blame,给出 commit 与行号证据

say.text: 帮我找出哪次提交引入了这个 bug
say.note: 已知好坏范围时会用 git bisect

howto.what_en: Claude takes over Git work: atomic commits, rebase/squash rewrites, and blame/bisect/reflog history questions. It reads repo state before inferring, writes only when you ask, and reports commit hashes with command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a Git-history investigation; skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into atomic commits
say_en.note: Groups the diff by behavior and stages each group
Uses git blame and cites commit and line evidence

say_en.text: Find which commit introduced this bug
say_en.note: Uses git bisect when good/bad bounds are known
